mainEntity.name: How does Core Sculpting differ from general ab workouts?

acceptedAnswer.text: Core Sculpting at Cave Training distinguishes itself from general ab workouts by focusing on the entire 'core' — a complex system of muscles including the abdominals, obliques, lower back, and hips, rather than just the superficial abdominal muscles. General ab workouts often target aesthetics, while Core Sculpting prioritizes functional strength, stability, and injury prevention, which are critical for overall fitness and daily movement. Practical Tradeoff: While both can improve appearance, Core Sculpting offers broader benefits for athletic performance and spinal health by integrating stability and power movements.
acceptedAnswer.description: Core Sculpting targets the entire core for functional strength and stability, while general ab workouts often focus only on superficial abdominal muscles for aesthetics.
